description: Read status and timestamps using the separate receipt token. Never returns ciphertext or plaintext and does not consume the secret. Status is a server event, not proof a person read it. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.

receipt_token.description: The receipt_token returned once at creation. Reads metadata or burns; cannot reveal.

secret_id.description: The secret_id returned at creation; not a credential.

name: read_one_time_secret_receipt
title: Read one-time secret status
